title: Round-trip recovery of the restriction from a processed clause
statement: Let $t$ be a term on $n$ variables, let $\mathit{lits}$ be a list of literals each tagged with a position index, and let $\mathit{path}$ be a list of variable–direction pairs. Let $\rho_0$, $\sigma$, and $\sigma_{\mathrm{dec}}$ be restrictions on $n$ variables, and suppose that every variable occurring in a literal of $\mathit{lits}$ is free under $\rho_0$; that every tagged literal in $\mathit{lits}$ occurs at its recorded position in $t$; that $\sigma$ is free at every variable that is free under $\rho_0$; and that $\sigma_{\mathrm{dec}}$ agrees with $\sigma$ at every variable that $\rho_0$ fixes. Write $(\mathit{path}', \rho_0', \sigma', a)$ for the result of processing $\mathit{lits}$ along $\mathit{path}$ starting from $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$, where $a$ is the accumulated list of (position, direction) pairs. Then for every variable $v$ that $\rho_0'$ fixes, the restriction obtained by folding over $a$ — starting from $\sigma_{\mathrm{dec}}$ and, for each recorded pair with position $i$, freeing the variable of the literal at position $i$ in $t$ (and leaving the restriction unchanged when $i$ lies beyond the end of $t$) — agrees with $\sigma$ at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: every variable in a literal of lits is free under ρ₀ (hfree_lits)
every tagged literal in lits occurs at its recorded position in t (hmem_zip)
σ is free wherever ρ₀ is free (hE)
σ_dec agrees with σ wherever ρ₀ is fixed (hC)
v is a variable at which the processed restriction ρ₀' is fixed (hv)
replaced:
Under the freeness and membership hypotheses on $\mathit{lits}$ and the agreement of
$\sigma_{\mathrm{dec}}$ with $\sigma$ on variables set by $\rho_0$, the $\sigma$-fold over
the aux entries (which clears $l.\mathrm{var}$ for each dropped head literal $l$) applied to
$\sigma_{\mathrm{dec}}$ agrees with $\sigma$ at every variable $v$ where the processed
restriction $(\mathrm{processClauseLits}\ \mathit{lits}\ \mathit{path}\ \rho_0\ \sigma).2.1$
is set.
